notes.page_content: A landscape cancelled algebra draft with two main columns. The left gives relations and an expansion in lambda, an independent e₂/e₃ block, an upside-down marginal start, and two delta starts. The right gives a parameterized relation system, a descending associativity calculation, a circled beta result, a signed delta result, and two final identities.

author_uncertainty.description: No explicit prose statement of uncertainty was read. Editorial uncertainty is retained only at the recorded ink loci.

notes.cancellation: Two long diagonal strokes cross both columns. H acknowledges this whole-page cancellation in its opening note; no false H omission row is assigned for that note. Local strikes are recorded separately.
mathematics_led_reading_decisions: The upper-right even-case coefficient initially looked like 1+alpha in the half image. Crop 08 shows one vertical numeral 1 immediately touching the minus bar; no separate plus-sign vertical was isolated. The written (1−alpha) is retained from direct ink, with no alteration to the witnesses.
The lower even-case eta subscript remains i−1|i+1. The adjacent expressions were used to locate the mark, not to replace it by the mathematically expected index.
The six dotted i indices in the lambda expansion were read individually. H gives 1 at those places; the proposed page preserves i.
The terminal f(d−3)e₁ is preserved as written. No algebraic repair or proof verification was performed.

unassigned_surface_traces.description: Several very pale short curves/vertical traces occur between the signed result and final identities. Their status as recto writing is unresolved, and no legible token is proposed. Their location is retained in a reading.tex comment.
A pale short dash/smudge appears above the e₂ block. The crop shows diffuse traces in the paper background. No legible token is proposed; the location is retained in a reading.tex comment.

notes.witness_apparatus: H note explanations were treated as apparatus, not manuscript words. Three bare descriptive introductions outside H notes and its duplicated left member are reported explicitly so the root can distinguish editorial linearization from literal ink.
notes.crop_scope: Whole image and each supplied half viewed once. Each of 15 crop files was generated once and viewed once. Crop 04 clips the lower part of the first f(i+1) annotation at the edge; that annotation had already been settled on half a and is supported there. Crop 04’s unresolved lower second annotation is fully contained. No place was recropped.
